entries.text: You see the Fargo Traders Caravan Driver.
entries.source_text: You see the Fargo Traders Caravan Driver.

entries.text: Hi, if you're wantin' a job on a caravan, you should talk to Rutger.  He's just over there.
entries.source_text: Hi, if you're wantin' a job on a caravan, you should talk to Rutger.  He's just over there.

entries.text: You're gonna need to talk to Rutger.

entries.text: So you signed up.  Good to hear it.  So ya know, we leave just about every ten days. That's the 8th, 18th, and 28th of each month.  Right now we're making runs to The Brotherhood, Junktown and the LA Boneyard.
entries.source_text: So you signed up.  Good to hear it.  So ya know, we leave just about every ten days. That's the 8th, 18th, and 28th of each month.  Right now we're making runs to The Brotherhood, Junktown and the LA Boneyard.

entries.text: You'll get 400 hubbucks. You might be sayin' that it ain't that much, but we go out often and you ain't gonna lose your life that easy.  But you get that pay going each way, not that you have to go each way, but you'll get a total of 800 if you do.

entries.text: We're headin' out today.  You interested?

entries.text: I'll still give you a job, even though... never mind.  Are you interested?

entries.text: 嗨，如果你想找工作就去找罗格尔。他正好就在那边。

entries.text: 你能得到400个瓶盖。你也许会说那不是很多，但是我们经常出发，你也不会那么容易挂掉。还有，你可以自己选择走哪条路线，不是你必须每条路都走一趟。交差后你一共会得800个瓶盖。

entries.text: 我们今天就要上路。你有兴趣吗？
entries.source_text: 我们今天就要上路。你有兴趣吗？

entries.text: 我这一直都有活做，甚至……没关系。你感兴趣吗？

entries.text: 好吧。没问题。如果你改变主意了就再来找我吧。

entries.text: Man, you don't seem to be doing well.   You should get something in your stomach, just stay clar of Bob's.

entries.text: Cuz I'm a mean green moth'a from outer space, and I'm... 'bad'!

entries.text: 啊，对不起大家伙。如果你左脚右脚都分不清，就不能给你工作。

entries.text: Not sure what happened, but the whole caravan was lost.  Funny thing for something like that to happen, and for you to be the only one left standing?  Things don't generally fall that way.  I just don't think I can hire you anymore because of it.  I'm sure you understand why.
